title: Building a template: editing axle rows, reference file and axle count
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A template with a Per axle field and a standalone Measurement field. Seed it: Settings - Service > Inspection Templates > New template (or Edit), use Add field to add the fields, then Save.
custom_steps:
1. Rename a row in place (confirm with a check, dismiss with an X) and confirm no dialog appears.
2. Add and remove rows; confirm the last row cannot be removed.
3. Confirm the per-axle field can carry a reference file like any other field (per S11), and that the template holds only how many axles the technician starts with (a starting point, never validated against recorded axles).
4. Add a standalone Measurement field and confirm it defaults to inches, with inches first in the unit list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Rows are renamed in place, confirmed with a check and dismissed with an X, without a dialog.
  • Rows can be added and removed, but the last row cannot be removed.
  • A per-axle field can carry a reference file like any other field.
  • The template holds only how many axles the technician starts with; the fill screen keeps Add Axle and per-axle delete, and the recorded axles are never validated against it.
  • A standalone Measurement field defaults to inches, with inches first in the unit list.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9106 (S8 — Record measurements per axle); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S8; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R6: “Rows will be renamed in place, confirmed with a check and dismissed with an X, without a dialog”
  • S8-R7: “Rows can be added and removed. The last row cannot be removed”
  • S8-R8: “A per-axle field will carry a reference file like any other field, as defined in S11”
  • S8-R9: “The template will hold how many axles the technician starts with, and nothing more. It is a starting point rather than a shape: the fill screen keeps Add Axle and per-axle delete, and the recorded axles are never validated against it”
  • S8-R28: “A standalone Measurement field will default to inches, and inches will be first in the unit list. Most of what a shop measures is read in inches, so the common case should not be a scroll away”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
